# TraceMaster

> TraceMaster PPE vending machines: TraceTurn, TraceBox and TraceLocker dispense PPE by ID badge with per-person limits, and track stock and usage in real time.

TraceMaster makes PPE and industrial vending machines and smart lockers, and represents CribMaster.
Plants and showrooms in Kocaeli and Manisa. Parent company: ATM Isı Transfer A.Ş.
Contact: info@tracemaster.com.tr, +90 532 760 00 07.
The site is bilingual: Turkish at /, English at /en/.

## Products
- [TraceMaster PPE Vending Machines](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/tracemaster/)
  - [TraceTurn](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/tracemaster/#traceturn): PPE dispenser with a 10″ touchscreen.
  - [TraceBox](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/tracemaster/#tracebox): 16-compartment accessory PPE cabinet for bulky items.
  - [TraceLocker-30](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/tracemaster/#tracelocker-30): 30-compartment accessory cabinet complementing the vending machine.
  - [TraceLocker-32](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/tracemaster/#tracelocker-32): 32-compartment accessory PPE cabinet.
- [CribMaster Inventory Vending Machines](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/cribmaster/)
  - [ProStock](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/cribmaster/#prostock)
  - [WeighStation](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/cribmaster/#weighstation)
  - [ToolBox](https://www.tracemaster.com.tr/en/products/cribmaster/#toolbox)
